To the ProductCo Engineering Team,

I am excited to apply for the Full Stack Engineer position. My career has been defined by my ability to build robust, scalable systems from the ground up. With deep roots in Python and extensive experience in modern frontend frameworks, I am well-equipped to handle the full lifecycle of feature development. I pride myself on writing clean, testable code and mentoring junior developers. Your focus on building the future of SaaS resonates with my passion for product-driven engineering. I am eager to bring my 20 years of experience to ProductCo and help build world-class software.

Best regards,
